tracesTo: UserFlow: Weekly Member Engagement, Feed Interaction, Pick'ems & History Browsing

stories.title: View League Season Archive List
stories.goal: see a list of all completed and current seasons for my league
stories.benefit: I can explore the league's history and access past seasons to review previous results
acceptanceCriteria: System displays all seasons in reverse chronological order (most recent first)
Each season entry shows season year, final champion, runner-up, and completion status
Current season is clearly marked and distinguished from historical seasons
Dynasty leagues show continuous season history with year-over-year progression
Redraft leagues show independent seasons with roster reset indicators
Season list is accessible from league navigation menu or dedicated history page

stories.title: View Season Summary Page
stories.goal: see comprehensive summary of a specific season including key stats and outcomes
stories.benefit: I can review complete season results, final standings, and significant moments from any past season
acceptanceCriteria: Season summary page displays season year, league format, and number of teams
Page shows final standings table with all teams ranked by playoff outcome and record
Summary includes champion and runner-up with team names, managers, and final scores
Page displays regular season winner/top seed if different from playoff champion
Key season statistics are shown (total points scored, highest scoring week, etc.)
Summary includes links to detailed views for matchups, power rankings, and rosters from that season

stories.title: Display Championship Game Results
stories.goal: see detailed results of the championship matchup for any season
stories.benefit: I can review how championships were won and see the final game details
acceptanceCriteria: Championship section shows both finalist teams with logos, managers, and final scores
System displays score breakdown by player if data is available from fantasy platform
Championship week number and date are clearly indicated
System shows margin of victory and whether game was close or blowout
Links to full matchup detail and playoff bracket context are provided
Historical championships preserve data even if teams no longer exist in current season

stories.title: Display Runner-Up and Playoff Finishers
stories.goal: see who finished second, third, and other playoff positions for a season
stories.benefit: I can understand the complete playoff results and see who made deep runs
acceptanceCriteria: Season summary clearly identifies runner-up (championship game loser)
System displays third place finisher if consolation/third place game exists
All playoff participants are shown with their final ranking/finish position
Non-playoff teams are displayed separately with regular season rankings
Playoff structure diagram or summary explains how finishing positions were determined
Historical playoff results are preserved regardless of current league roster changes

stories.title: Access Historical Week Links from Season Archive
stories.goal: navigate to specific weeks within archived seasons to review matchups and content
stories.benefit: I can explore detailed week-by-week history and see what happened during specific periods
acceptanceCriteria: Season summary page includes week-by-week navigation or timeline
Clicking a historical week loads that week's matchups, scores, and published content
Historical weeks show power rankings, matchup features, and predictions from that time
System preserves links even if current league interface has changed
Week links clearly indicate which weeks had commissioner content published vs basic matchups
Navigation allows browsing through weeks sequentially within archived seasons

stories.title: View Dynasty League Continuity Across Seasons
stories.goal: see how my dynasty team and league evolved across multiple seasons
stories.benefit: I can track long-term team building, roster evolution, and sustained success or struggles
acceptanceCriteria: Dynasty season archives show clear season-to-season connections and transitions
System displays roster carryover and how teams changed between seasons
Manager tenure and team ownership history is tracked across seasons
Championship recaps highlight repeat winners and dynasty building success
System shows franchise records and multi-season statistics for dynasty context
Historical views indicate when managers joined, left, or took over teams

stories.title: View Redraft League Season Independence
stories.goal: see each redraft season as independent with clear roster resets
stories.benefit: I understand that each season is a fresh start without confusion about roster continuity
acceptanceCriteria: Redraft season archives clearly indicate 'Fresh Draft' or 'New Season' status
System does not imply roster continuity between redraft seasons
Each season summary shows draft order and draft results as starting point
Manager participation history is tracked even though rosters reset
System displays which managers returned vs new managers for each season
Season summaries emphasize yearly champion rather than franchise continuity

stories.title: View Historical Power Rankings by Season
stories.goal: see all published power rankings from a specific past season
stories.benefit: I can review commissioner commentary and see how team rankings evolved throughout a season
acceptanceCriteria: Season archive links to dedicated historical power rankings view for that season
All weeks with published power rankings are accessible with week-by-week navigation
Historical rankings display exactly as they appeared when originally published
Commissioner commentary is preserved and displayed with each ranking
System shows trajectory chart for historical season if data is available
Links to contemporary matchups and feed moments from ranking publication are maintained

stories.title: View Historical Pick'ems Results by Season
stories.goal: see pick'ems participation and results from past seasons
stories.benefit: I can review who performed best at predictions and see historical accuracy
acceptanceCriteria: Season archive includes pick'ems history section with weekly results
System displays season-long pick'ems leaderboard for that historical season
Individual weekly pick'ems results are accessible for all participants
Historical pick'ems data shows who participated each week and their accuracy
System preserves pick'ems stats even if participants are no longer in league
Links to specific weeks allow viewing exact picks and outcomes from the past

stories.title: View All-Time League Records and Milestones
stories.goal: see cumulative records across all seasons such as most championships, best record, highest score
stories.benefit: I can understand league history and see who has achieved the most success over time
acceptanceCriteria: League history page includes 'All-Time Records' section aggregating across seasons
System displays records for most championships, best regular season record, most wins, etc.
Highest single-game score and highest season total points are shown with context
Manager-level cumulative stats are displayed (most playoff appearances, win percentage)
Records indicate which season(s) the achievement occurred in with clickable links
System handles manager changes and team ownership transitions appropriately

stories.title: Search and Filter Historical Seasons
stories.goal: filter season archives by criteria like championship winner, year range, or format
stories.benefit: I can quickly find specific historical seasons without scrolling through entire history
acceptanceCriteria: Season archive list includes search/filter controls
User can filter by champion name or manager to find their winning seasons
Year range filter allows selecting specific time periods
Dynasty vs redraft filter if league has changed formats over time
Filter results update immediately and show matching seasons only
System indicates how many seasons match current filter criteria

stories.title: View Manager Historical Performance Profile
stories.goal: see a specific manager's performance across all seasons they participated in
stories.benefit: I can understand individual manager's legacy and long-term success patterns
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking a manager name in league history opens their historical profile
Profile shows all seasons manager participated in with win-loss records
Championships, runner-up finishes, and playoff appearances are highlighted
Profile displays manager's cumulative stats (total wins, winning percentage, etc.)
Season-by-season breakdown shows progression and performance trends
Profile links back to specific season summaries for detailed exploration
